faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions on Deluxe Camping in Cafe Cherrapunji

items.question: 1. Are breakfast provided at the Cafe Cherrapunji Campsite?

answer.text: Yes, the camping package includes complimentary breakfast, offered in the deluxe tent.

items.question: 2. What type of breakfast is provided in Cafe Cherrapunji deluxe camping?

answer.text: Indian and Asian dishes are available for breakfast.

items.question: 3. Does deluxe camping at Cafe Cherrapunji provide bedding, blankets and pillows?

answer.text: Yes, it is a deluxe tent equipped with modern amenities.

items.question: 4. Is there a bonfire arrangement at the campsite during the stay?

answer.text: Yes, a bonfire is arranged while camping at Cafe Cherrapunji.

items.question: 5. Is there a parking facility available at the campsite?

answer.text: Yes, there is parking space available inside the Cafe Cherrapunji for two-wheelers as well as four-wheelers.

items.question: 6. Are luggage storage facilities available during Cafe Cehrrapunji Tent Stay?

answer.text: You can store your luggage inside the tents but incase of valuable items you can keep it with the owner.
